text:
Mid-afternoon, a small mix-up led the cargo lead to ask questions and caused a brief delay in the handoff of a companion animal booking. Incident report: cabin warmth review and pet transfer concern. The traveler, Eva Santos, had been given clear pre-departure guidance, but the crew became concerned when the kennel area felt warmer than expected during loading. The Companion Animal Travel Desk was notified at once, and the customer was met with calm and respectful attention. <<FACT F119>> The senior coordinator listened carefully, checked the routing notes, and confirmed that the pet, Gus, remained secure, hydrated, and under observation. A second review of the cabin conditions followed, and the cargo team adjusted the handling process so the transfer could continue without further distress. <<FACT F111>> The traveler was kept informed throughout, and the concern was handled without argument or delay.

After the immediate response, the desk logged the event, reviewed the handoff sequence, and confirmed that the communication gap had been isolated to the loading stage. The customer was offered reassurance, and the pet was observed again before the journey proceeded. The follow-up will include a review of briefing clarity, a reminder to the crew about thermal checks, and a check that future companion animal transfers are confirmed more smoothly. Aurelia Skyways regrets the upset this caused and remains committed to careful, humane handling at every stage. Companion Animal Travel Desk
